# All Seasons Air — LSA Call Wins Log (Oct 1–15, 2026)

Scope: Google Local Services Ads leads only. These calls don't go through CallRail. Lead list, status, and recordings were pulled from the Google Ads LSA API (account 8655979348, `local_services_lead` + `local_services_lead_conversation`) and transcribed locally. One line per lead; leads with several calls are merged into one line.

**Caveat:** names and spelled details come from an auto-generated transcript on phone-quality audio. "Google status" is what the business marked in the LSA dashboard, and the outcome tag is what the calls show. Nearly every lead is still "Active" in the dashboard, so the office isn't updating statuses.

**Patterns to flag:**
- **Big-ticket leads are waiting on callbacks.** An oil-to-gas conversion plus central air estimate (10-13), a $12–15k boiler install asking about financing (10-02), and an annual maintenance contract (10-07) are all open.
- **Price objections on the $195 diagnostic.** At least two callers (10-06 Oceanside, 10-08 Fixify) got the rate and didn't book.
- **Dispute candidate:** the 10-12 message lead asked about **oil** boiler maintenance, which All Seasons doesn't do, and it was **charged**.

**Outcome legend:** ✅ Booked · ⏳ Open/follow-up needed · ❌ No contact / not a lead
